claim: Seven reference engineering stacks and their common relationships. Arrows show relationships among capabilities that recurred in one system, not a required architecture or adoption order. Resource Mediation and Context Delivery are shown separately because they provide useful capabilities independently.
topology: Five related capabilities in convergent hierarchy; resource mediation and context delivery deliberately disconnected.
required_terms: Model coherence\ stays joined to reality
Context delivery\ knowledge at point of work
bw_encoding: White ordinary nodes and groups; labels and boundaries carry roles without decorative tones.
redesign: Native nodes and routed edges preserve the original semantic structure, with print-sized labels and fewer decorative frames. Grayscale refinement: Coherence, mechanism stacks, and governance conversion regain distinct semantic families; detached independent stacks remain detached.
alt:
Seven capability boxes. Model coherence (representation stays joined to reality) sits at
    the top and commonly relates downward to two stacks: assurance (obligations get discharged) and
    auditable transformation (change is legible). Those two commonly relate on to observe-react (detect and
    act), which relates on to governance conversion (useful judgment becomes capital). The arrows show relationships
    that recurred in practice, not a floor the stacks rest on. Two further stacks — resource mediation
    (govern contention) and context delivery (right knowledge at the point of work) — sit detached at the
    bottom with no inbound arrow, because they are useful independently of the other stacks.

style_review.fill: White ordinary nodes and groups; labels and boundaries carry roles without decorative tones.

style_review.shape: Ordinary boxes use modest rounded corners; semantic document, state, decision, marker and quantitative shapes retain their roles.
style_review.visual_review: Common relations orthogonal; resource mediation and context delivery still detached.
style_review.routing_exceptions: Outer return paths retained where needed to show feedback without crossing forward flow.
